data.title: 陆八魔阿露 · 雨夜街巷的狼狈颜艺抓包
data.description: 大雨滂沱的后街暗巷，积水倒映着昏黄路灯。任务彻底搞砸的阿露怀抱着浸湿的委托文件箱，双手手忙脚乱地护住账单。看到迎面打伞赶来的老师，这位硬派社长当场破防，眼眶泛着泪花、双颊滚烫通红，露出了灵魂出窍般的招牌绝望颜艺。
data.action: clutching wet documents, panicked tears, flustered blush, hilarious panic face
data.lighting: rain-slicked amber streetlight reflection through downpour
data.mood: hilarious comic panic and endearing helplessness
data.promptProse: In a rain-drenched city alley at night, Rikuhachima Aru clutches damp papers in utter flustered panic, eyes welling with comic tears as she spots the viewer.
data.animaCaption: Aru looking flustered and panicked in a rainy alley as her plans go wrong.
